title: 「It remains unclear whether + clause」表示「某事仍未能確定」
titleZh: 「It remains unclear whether + 子句」表示「某事仍未能確定」
titleEn: Using “It remains unclear whether” for unresolved questions

source.file: Sentence Structure 272 - 「It remains unclear whether + clause」表示「某事仍未能確定」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 272; it is assigned system ID ss273 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: It + remains + unclear + whether + complete clause

formulas.formula: It may / might / will / would remain unclear whether + clause
It remains unclear whether + alternative A + or + alternative B
Subject + reporting verb + that + it remains unclear whether + clause

example: It remains unclear whether the decline will continue.
exampleZh: 目前仍未能確定跌幅會否持續。

examples.en: It remains unclear whether the decline will continue.
examples.zh: 目前仍未能確定跌幅會否持續。
examples.highlight: It remains unclear whether the decline will continue.

meaning.zh: 當現有資料仍不足以對一個是非問題作出明確答案時，這個句型客觀指出不確定情況仍然持續。

rules.zh: 後面使用陳述句語序，不使用問句倒裝語序。
rules.en: Use statement word order after whether: “whether the plan will work”, not “whether will the plan work.”

rules.zh: 後面必須接完整子句，通常包括主語和動詞。
rules.en: A complete clause with its own subject and verb must follow whether.

rules.zh: 這句表示結果仍未能確定，並不表示失敗的可能性較高。
rules.en: Unclear means that the answer is not yet known; it does not mean that a negative outcome is more likely.

rules.zh: 表示現在未能確定。 It remains unclear whether the decline will continue. 表示經過一段時間、討論或研究後，仍然未能確定。 Remains 強調不確定情況一直持續至今。
rules.en: Remains marks continuing uncertainty after time, discussion or investigation, rather than merely stating that something is unclear now.

rules.zh: 原句描述過去情況，因此答案使用 remained，並保留 had started。
rules.en: Preserve tense and modality. Past uncertainty normally takes remained, and the whether-clause keeps the source sentence's time relationship.

rules.zh: 在部分日常句子中，if 可以表達相近意思，但本練習只接受 whether。
rules.en: Whether is the required connector in this lesson; do not replace it with if.

rules.zh: 學生只需表示「仍未確定」，不能自行加入負面結論。
rules.en: Do not change an unresolved question into a negative conclusion or add an unsupported judgement.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能準確表示「目前資料不足，仍未有答案」，避免在沒有足夠證據時作出猜測。
benefits.en: It expresses uncertainty accurately instead of guessing or giving an answer without enough evidence.

benefits.zh: 第一句把重點放在說話者「不知道」；第二句則把重點放在現有資料仍不足以得出答案，語氣較客 觀。
benefits.en: It sounds more objective than “I don't know” because it focuses on the situation and available evidence rather than personal knowledge.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以幫助學生避免把未經證實的事情當作事實，有助作出較謹慎和準確的陳述。
benefits.en: It helps learners make careful claims and avoid presenting an uncertain idea as a proven fact.

benefits.zh: 你可以先交代已完成的研究、調查或討論，再指出仍然無法確定的問題。 Example: After reviewing the evidence, it remains unclear whether the claim is true. （檢視證據後，目前仍未能確定該項說法是否屬實。）
benefits.en: It connects evidence with an unresolved question by showing what has been investigated and what still cannot be confirmed.

benefits.zh: 這個句型特別適合用於討論研究結果、公共政策、調查、商業表現或未來變化。
benefits.en: It is useful in reports, essays and presentations about research, policy, investigations, business results and possible future changes.

benefits.zh: 核心句式可以放在句首、背景子句之後，或引述結構之內，使寫作不會反覆使用完全相同的句 式。
benefits.en: It allows genuine sentence variety because the core can appear initially, after background information or inside a reporting structure.

Preserve the original meaning, tense, modality, alternatives and reporting context, and follow the supplied first word.
